definitions.explanation: Attaches to nouns to indicate type, lineage, or category. Used for ethnic/national descent, family lines, scientific systems, and stylistic categories of fashion, music, or character.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{理|り}{系|けい}だ。
⟦アフリカ→アフリカ：01767_afurika⟧{系|けい}⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I studied the history of African Americans.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{癒|いや}し→癒し：13604_iyashi⟧{系|けい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聴|き}く→聴く：30010_kiku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Lately I often listen to relaxing-style music.

notes:
Attaches to a noun to mark category, lineage, or style. Highly productive in casual classification of people, fashion, music, food, and academic fields.

COMPOUNDS:
- {理|り}{系|けい}: science track (in school)
- {文|ぶん}{系|けい}: humanities track
- ⟦アジア→アジア：01763_ajia⟧{系|けい}: of Asian descent
- ⟦{体育|たいいく}→体育：03384_taiiku⟧⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧{系|けい}: athletic-club type (often describing a personality)
- ⟦{癒|いや}し→癒し：13604_iyashi⟧{系|けい}: soothing, healing style
- ⟦{太陽|たいよう}{系|けい}→太陽系：12216_taiyoukei⟧: solar system

USAGE:
With descent words (⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{系|けい}, ⟦アフリカ→アフリカ：01767_afurika⟧{系|けい}), often combined with a nationality: ⟦アフリカ→アフリカ：01767_afurika⟧{系|けい}⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧ (African American). In casual speech, ~{系|けい}⟦{女子|じょし}→女子：03350_joshi⟧ or ~{系|けい}⟦{男子|だんし}→男子：03425_danshi⟧ classifies personality or fashion type.
